title: the box-run rehearsal's build cases refused at b06 on a CI runner (a torn host tree)

findings.claim: tools/host_tree.pack read each file twice (hash, then tar): a file that changed in between gave a host tree that did not match its own HOST-SHA256SUMS, and verify_update.py refused the signed bundle at b06 (the rehearsal's build cases on train 99's CI run; make_bundle.sh packs with the same function, so a tree edited during a vendor's pack fails closed on every box); pack now hashes while copying into a snapshot and tars the snapshot
